method.source_ir_layer: up:chant only; pitched events sorted by rational onset then event id
method.physical_attack_definition: exclude the immediate next pitched event after each IR event with tieToNext=true; verify continuation pitch equals tied pitch
method.target: data/chants.json chant 442 parsed with pipeline.typeset.proof_notes.read_gabc(expand=True), expanding marked ij first Alleluia repeat
method.physical_target_alignment: raw 142-note sequences first compared strictly and found exactly equal; then drop the same eight 0-based tied-continuation indices from target GABC, corresponding to repeated heads at those exact positions
method.alteration_units: IR Pitch.alter is semitones, divided by 2 to match proof_notes.Note whole-tone alteration units
